{{Quote|The planet Skine resisted the Hegemony's demands to surrender. Hammer Station reduced its capital city to ashes two hours ago.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="Hammer" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Advozse Hegemony]] attempted to force the surrender of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skine]] during their [[Advozsec expansion|military expansion]] using the prototype [[Hammer Station]] battle station. When Skine refused to surrender, the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] '''bombarded''' the [[Skine's capital city|capital city]] of Skine with the Hammer's capability to launch [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] at targets.<ref name="Hammer" />
